job.job_title: Software Engineer – Data Science (Python, Generative AI & LLMs
job.job_description:
Designation : Senior Software Engineer / Software Engineer 

Location : Airoli , Navi Mumbai 

Work from Office 

Role 

Design, develop, and maintain Python-based ML/AI applications
Build and optimize ML/NLP models and integrate into production systems
Implement and fine-tune LLMs and GenAI solutions for business needs
Design and manage database structures for ML applications and data pipelines
Deploy and monitor ML models in cloud environments (AWS/Azure)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams for solution delivery
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and provide feedback
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in production
Stay updated with trends in ML, NLP, and GenAI

 

Skillset Requirements:

Experience: 3.5–5 years in Python
Python Programming: Minimum 3.5 years
Machine Learning/NLP: At least 1+ years
LLM & GenAI: Minimum 1+ years
Database Management: At least 2 years
Cloud Deployment: 1+ years on Azure or AWS
LLMOps: Familiarity is a plus
